substantive_checks.generic_state: PASS: the invertible order-two recurrence leaves two algebraically free formal state coordinates X,Y, and every fixed window is an A-linear form in them
substantive_checks.full_kernel: PASS: quotienting A[X,Y,U] by (X,U+Y^2) is canonically A[Y], proving the exact recurrence-universal kernel
substantive_checks.n_only_monic_no_go: PASS: substitution U=-Y^2 leaves the uncancellable leading term (-1)^dY^(2d) for every positive-degree monic M in A[U]
substantive_checks.rational_denominators: PASS: denominator clearing is admitted only where the common denominator is a target unit; nonunit target factors are not hidden in a formal monic relation
substantive_checks.state_dependent_scope: PASS: universal state-dependent relations are classified as (U+Y^2)G+XH and explicitly labeled tautological after actual-orbit specialization
substantive_checks.proper_target_kernel: PASS: Z[Y,U]/(Q,U+Y^2) is (Z/QZ)[Y], so identities valid for arbitrary boundary state modulo Q lie exactly in the displayed ideal
substantive_checks.degree_one: PASS: U+a annihilates -Y^2 modulo Q exactly when -a is an integer lift of the boundary unit; this is precisely the Item285 small-lift problem
substantive_checks.orbit_specific_boundary: PASS: no impossibility claim is made for arithmetic congruences special to the seed q_0=q_1=1 or for proper de-overlapped targets
substantive_checks.resultant_and_baseline: PASS: the Item285 resultant criterion remains conditional and the Item282 common-product baseline remains separate
substantive_checks.capacity_booking: PASS: no actual orbit-specific low-height relation or target bound is proved; beta capacity reduction and Route-1 booking are zero

strict_scope.proved: The beta recurrence alone supplies only the canonical boundary relation and recurrence modulus; no n-only recurrence-universal monic annihilator exists.
strict_scope.not_excluded: A low-height relation special to the integral seed, a proper-target congruence, or a nonzero low-height resultant using new arithmetic.
strict_scope.open: The least-height actual boundary-unit lift, higher-degree orbit-specific annihilators, the Item282 product baseline, and every positive beta capacity theorem.
